CustomField.description: Creates a Group Category based on the Days Since Last Visit. Used for Reporting.
CustomField.formula: IF(Days_Since_Last_Visit__c <= 30, "1. 0 - 30 Days",IF(Days_Since_Last_Visit__c <= 60,"2. 31 - 60 Days",IF(Days_Since_Last_Visit__c <= 90,"3. 61 - 90 Days",IF(ISNULL(Days_Since_Last_Visit__c),"5. Never Visited","4. >90 Days"))))
CustomField.label: Last Visit Group
